research_questions.question: Which entities belong in the selected parent reporting perimeter?
research_questions.scope: US domestic registrant parent and assumed controlled operating subsidiary; 2025 synthetic close; separate financial-reporting and federal tax purposes.
research_questions.answer: Start with reporting purpose and evidence of control. Apply the selected registrant rule with its ownership exceptions; retain a separate conclusion for each entity and disclose material perimeter changes. A passive holding company can still have a controlled subsidiary. A management-service contract alone does not settle control. Public-company use of the private-company alternative remains outside this scope.

research_questions.question: How do standalone investment balances connect to the subsidiary equity and consolidation worksheet?
research_questions.scope: US domestic registrant parent and assumed controlled operating subsidiary; 2025 synthetic close; separate financial-reporting and federal tax purposes.
research_questions.answer: Match the parent investment to the subsidiary capital and acquisition/inception history. The fixture starts a wholly owned subsidiary at cash contributed equal to share capital and keeps the parent cost ledger as a clearly labeled worksheet input. Its investment/capital elimination is not a conclusion about the required standalone investment method. Reuse the investment and entity-change foundations for equity-method, fair-value, impairment, acquisition and loss-of-control questions.

research_questions.question: How are an intercompany loan and accrued interest reconciled at close?
research_questions.scope: US domestic registrant parent and assumed controlled operating subsidiary; 2025 synthetic close; separate financial-reporting and federal tax purposes.
research_questions.answer: Reconcile both entities by agreement, counterparty, principal, currency, rate and accrual period. The fixture assumes a 6% annual rate on unchanged principal for one full year. Principal and accrued-interest reciprocal balances and in-group interest income/expense are eliminated in the group column after matching. External borrowing, impairment, debt/equity substance, transfer pricing and legal enforceability require their own evidence.

research_questions.question: When does a management-service charge differ from passive holding activity?
research_questions.scope: US domestic registrant parent and assumed controlled operating subsidiary; 2025 synthetic close; separate financial-reporting and federal tax purposes.
research_questions.answer: Document the actual service and recipient benefit before choosing a cost driver. For controlled-service tax analysis, exclude activities whose sole effect protects the shareholder investment or meets the renderer-specific obligations; day-to-day management can differ. The original allocation case uses documented processing units, retains the renderer share and separates internal allocation from tax-method and markup conclusions. The charge and receipt are reciprocal entity entries, then eliminated within the assumed group.

research_questions.question: How are subsidiary distributions and tax consolidation kept separate in the close?
research_questions.scope: US domestic registrant parent and assumed controlled operating subsidiary; 2025 synthetic close; separate financial-reporting and federal tax purposes.
research_questions.answer: Tie the declared and paid dividend to both entity ledgers and its approval. The worksheet removes the parent dividend-income entry against the subsidiary distribution column. Financial and tax group memberships need separate decisions: the 2025 IRS instructions identify an 80% voting-power and value test for includible corporations and require separate forms and supporting reconciliations. The synthetic book elimination does not establish tax eligibility, a filing election, deductibility or distribution legality.

research_questions.question: How do the standalone ledgers and elimination column reconcile to the consolidated total?
research_questions.scope: US domestic registrant parent and assumed controlled operating subsidiary; 2025 synthetic close; separate financial-reporting and federal tax purposes.
research_questions.answer: Use independently balanced parent and subsidiary ledgers, match transaction IDs, and preserve an auditable elimination column. In the fixture the group retains only cash assets, external revenue, external expenses and parent capital. The displayed standalone, combined and group totals are recomputed from original journal lines. Counterparty differences, excluded entities and third-party revenue remain visible rather than being absorbed into an unexplained adjustment.
